title: Panettone French Toast with Fresh Berries
description: A delicious breakfast treat that combines the Italian classic panettone with fresh berries and a hint of citrus.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
2. Cut the panettone into 1-inch slices and place in the egg mixture, coating both sides.
3. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
4. Add butter to the skillet and melt.
5. Cook the panettone slices for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
6. Serve warm with fresh berries and a sprinkle of lemon zest.
